clips.title: The story
paras: At the Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart tests those who seek the respect of its hunters. The veteran dwarven hunter is stationed in south-eastern Loch Modan and keeps to the traditions of the wild.

At the Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart expects hunters to prove their skill. The lodge overlooks the lake from a ridge in south-eastern Loch Modan and gathers marksmen and trackers from across the dwarven lands. Marek pays little heed to titles or boasts. Anyone seeking the lodge’s respect must show practical skill against the beasts roaming Loch Modan, with the patience and nerve of a true hunter.
